jobs.title: Why the Moon Looks Huge This Week
jobs.description:
This Tuesday (Nov 24) the full Moon swings 45,000 km closer than its farthest point. That makes it a supermoon: up to 14% bigger and 30% brighter than the smallest full Moon. Look up when it rises - and December's supermoon comes even closer!

#supermoon #moon #space #science #shorts
